sections.title: The letter ha
paragraphs: The letter name is (ха) /xa/. Its main sound is in (хлеб) /xlʲep/, which means bread. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, lift the back of your tongue near the soft roof. Blow air through the narrow space. For the second sound, push your whole tongue forward and high. Put your hand on your throat. You feel no shake, because both sounds are voiceless. Voiceless means your throat does not shake.

sections.title: When to say each sound
paragraphs: You hear the first sound before hard consonants and most vowels, as in (хорошо) /xərəˈʂo/ and (сахар) /ˈsaxər/. You hear the second sound before front vowels and the soft sign, as in (химия) /ˈxʲimʲɪjə/ and (стихи) /sʲtʲɪˈxʲi/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not replace this sound with the gentle sound in hat. Push the air strongly against the soft roof of your mouth. Also do not stop the air like the sound in cat. Keep the air flowing smoothly without a sudden burst.
